method: Independent comparison of eight actual original and supplemental prompts, full responses and recorded MCP calls. Supplemental prompts include the shared skill preamble; this does not establish natural installed-skill discovery.
limitations: Eight single-run comparisons do not establish causality or a stable improvement rate.
Six supplemental runs contain no MCP calls. A configured server does not prove tool visibility or successful model discovery.
Response-quality verdicts are distinct from integration conclusions; a correct answer without a tool call does not verify the underlying memory state.
